meta.project: Converge - Centralized KYC Service for FinTech

product_overview: Converge is a centralized KYC (Know Your Customer) verification platform for the FinTech ecosystem. It simplifies and secures KYC processes by allowing users to complete verification once, share their verified status with third-party lending platforms securely, and track their credit scores based on financial transactions. It provides separate interfaces for users, admins, and partners to manage KYC workflows, document uploads, transaction management, and integration features.
core_goals: Enable secure and seamless KYC verification for users with a one-time submission process.
Provide a comprehensive credit score calculation based on users' transaction history.
Facilitate admin review of KYC applications with audit trails and mandatory rejection reasons.
Offer OAuth-like secure integration for trusted FinTech partners to verify KYC status and access user credit data.
Implement robust role-based access control and security best practices to protect user data and system integrity.
key_features: JWT-based user authentication with registration, login, and role-based access control (User, Admin, Partner).
KYC document upload and management supporting multiple document types (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport) with file validation and size limits.
End-to-end KYC submission and verification workflow allowing users to submit documents and admins to review, approve, or reject with reasons.
Financial transaction management enabling users to add, view, and filter credit/debit transactions.
CIBIL-style credit score engine calculating scores between 300-900 based on weighted transaction metrics including frequency, ratio, and recency.
User Dashboard displaying KYC status, credit score, and financial summaries for quick insights.
Admin panel providing a queue of pending KYC requests, document viewing, and detailed review functionality.
Partner integration with OAuth-like account linking, API key authentication, and secure data access for KYC verification and credit score retrieval.
Comprehensive request validation and global error handling middleware to ensure API robustness.
Secure password hashing (bcrypt), token management, CORS configuration, and protection against common web vulnerabilities.
user_flow_summary: User registers an account using the registration page, providing personal and contact information.
User logs in and accesses the document upload page to submit identity verification documents.
User submits the KYC application for admin review via the documents page interface.
Admin logs into the admin panel, reviews pending KYC applications, views uploaded documents, and approves or rejects applications with mandatory reasons.
User adds financial transactions from the transactions page, which triggers automatic recalculation of their credit score.
User accesses the dashboard to view their KYC verification status, current credit score, and transaction summaries.
Partners initiate an OAuth-like account linking process to access user data with consent, and verify KYC status and credit score via secure APIs.
validation_criteria: User registration and login must enforce password strength and proper input validation, returning appropriate error messages on failures.
KYC document uploads must accept only allowed file types (PDF, JPG, PNG) and respect the 5MB size limit.
Users should only be able to submit KYC applications after uploading required valid documents.
Admin must be able to approve or reject KYC submissions with mandatory rejection reasons, with actions recorded in the audit trail.
Financial transactions must be saved with correct types, amounts, and metadata, supporting pagination and filtering.
Credit score calculation must update accurately upon new transaction entries and conform to the specified weighted formula.
Role-based access control must restrict endpoints and UI access correctly based on user roles (User, Admin, Partner).
Partner API endpoints must require valid API keys and access tokens, and only return authorized data after user consent.
The API must validate all incoming requests and respond with consistent error formats under the global error handler.
Security measures, including JWT expiration, bcrypt hashing rounds, request validation, and CORS settings, must be enforced across the application.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: JWT-based authentication system with registration, login, and profile management. Includes password hashing with bcrypt and role-based access control.

features.name: KYC Document Management
features.description: Upload, manage, and review identity documents (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, etc.) for KYC verification. Supports file uploads with validation and admin review workflow.

features.name: KYC Verification Workflow
features.description: Complete KYC submission and review process. Users can submit documents for review, and admins can approve or reject with mandatory reasons. Includes audit trail.

features.name: Transaction Management
features.description: Create, view, and manage financial transactions (credit/debit). Supports pagination, filtering, and automatic credit score recalculation on transaction addition.

features.name: Credit Score Calculation
features.description: CIBIL-style credit score engine (300-900 range) that calculates scores based on transaction history. Uses weighted algorithm considering total transactions, average amount, credit/debit ratio, frequency, and recent activity.

features.name: User Dashboard
features.description: Dashboard displaying KYC status, credit score, financial summary, and quick access to key features.

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Admin interface for reviewing pending KYC requests, viewing documents, and approving/rejecting applications with reasons.

features.name: Partner Integration
features.description: OAuth-like account linking system for third-party partners (e.g., Slice). Partners can verify KYC status and retrieve user credit scores and transaction history with user consent.

features.name: Role-Based Access Control
features.description: Middleware and components for enforcing role-based access (User, Admin, Partner). Protected routes and API endpoints based on user roles.

features.name: Request Validation
features.description: Middleware for validating request data using express-validator. Ensures data integrity and prevents invalid requests.

features.name: Error Handling
features.description: Global error handler middleware for consistent error responses across the API.

features.name: Database Configuration
features.description: PostgreSQL database connection and configuration management.

features.name: API Client
features.description: Frontend API client with axios for making HTTP requests to the backend. Includes token management and error handling.

features.name: Navigation Components
features.description: Navigation bar and routing components for the React application.

features.name: Server Entry Point
features.description: Express server initialization with middleware setup, route registration, and health check endpoint.
